purpose: Validate the bounded authority and evidence contract for eventual implementation of Solar Optimiser issue #5 without implementing or changing Solar in this run.

grants.scope: Inspect the pinned target, issue #5, merged decision, governance adoption, and specifications for Harness preflight only.
Consume Governance baseline 1.1.0 as authoritative reference material.
Read the live issue #5 decision context.

prohibitions.scope: Do not implement, edit, commit, or push Solar feature changes in this Harness bootstrap run.
Do not copy, redefine, or edit authoritative Governance.
Do not merge any Solar pull request.
Do not deploy or release Solar.
Do not call FoxESS control operations or use live credentials.

criteria.criterion: Zero, one, and many discovered sites; empty, single, and multiple approval subsets; new, disappearing, and revoked sites; duplicate IDs; pagination; one inventory call; and legacy migration behave exactly as SOL-T-204 through SOL-T-210 require.
evidence_required: Fixture and integration results traced to each SOL-T-1406 scenario
Implementation evidence identifying the exact assessed Solar commit

criteria.criterion: No non-approved site or device data reaches telemetry calls, operational writes, evidence files, routine logs, alerts, or diagnostics beyond justified candidate metadata.
evidence_required: Independently derived negative-path tests for every prohibited sink
Review evidence for the approved metadata reduction boundary

criteria.criterion: Credential replacement or expanded visibility fails closed unless a stable identity and explicit migration rule are evidenced.
evidence_required: Credential replacement and newly visible site test results
Decision evidence for any future stable-identity migration rule

criteria.criterion: Every issue #5 criterion receives an EVI-001 result with supporting evidence and assessor provenance; unexercised live behaviour remains unverified.
evidence_required: Per-criterion result classification and evidence references
Explicit unverified classifications for unexercised live behaviour

decisions.summary: Account inventory discovery is bounded onboarding; telemetry collection requires explicit site approval and empty approval collects nothing.
decisions.basis: Least-capability, purpose-bound data, and installer or delegated keys that may expose multiple customers.
reassessment_triggers: Material change to FoxESS account or credential scoping capabilities
Material change to Solar tenancy, installer, or fleet-administration requirements

decisions.summary: Solar adopts Eceni Governance baseline 1.1.0 while retaining issue #5 as an outstanding implementation obligation.
decisions.authority: Solar governance adoption decision in merged PR #8
decisions.basis: Solar records baseline lineage and project applicability without claiming blanket conformance.
reassessment_triggers: Solar adopts a later Eceni Governance baseline
Issue #5 is satisfied or explicitly superseded

deferrals.summary: Live FoxESS end-to-end behaviour is verified during implementation rather than on every CI run.
deferrals.rationale: Live verification is quota-consuming and implementation or operation is the proportionate evidence-producing mechanism.
deferrals.trigger: An issue #5 implementation is available against an authorised real FoxESS connection.
acceptance_conditions: Live behaviour is assessed and classified under EVI-001
Unexercised behaviour remains unverified rather than Pass
Contrary findings return to Solar specification or design authority
deferrals.may_proceed: Fixture and integration implementation and independently derived CI-gating verification may proceed once separately authorised.
deferrals.may_not_proceed: Verified acceptance of unexercised live behaviour and production release claims may not proceed on fixture evidence alone.

follow_ups.summary: Obtain and cite explicit authority before implementing or changing Solar issue #5.
follow_ups.trigger: Before any issue #5 implementation write or execution run.
acceptance_conditions: A durable implementation grant identifies repository, scope, prohibitions, and decision authority
A new work-definition revision removes no prohibition without citing that grant

follow_ups.summary: Decide pending-site metadata storage, retention, and deletion behaviour.
follow_ups.trigger: Issue #5 implementation design before candidate metadata is durably retained.
acceptance_conditions: The minimum metadata set, location, retention, deletion, and recovery behaviour are recorded and reviewed

follow_ups.summary: Choose the Phase 1 approval mechanism and record actor identity evidence.
follow_ups.trigger: Issue #5 implementation design before approvals can be created or changed.
acceptance_conditions: The mechanism satisfies SOL-T-204 through SOL-T-210
The accountable approval actor and audit identity are explicit

follow_ups.summary: Evidence and design a stable FoxESS connection identity or retain fail-closed credential replacement.
follow_ups.trigger: Before any approval migration across credential replacement is implemented.
acceptance_conditions: Stable identity evidence and an explicit migration rule are approved, or replacement remains fail-closed

follow_ups.summary: Choose the minimum FoxESS inventory call set needed for approved onboarding and status behaviour.
follow_ups.trigger: Issue #5 implementation design before provider inventory calls are fixed.
acceptance_conditions: The call set satisfies UX, status, pagination, quota, and data-minimisation requirements without unnecessary retained data
